points.description: First blank: stem flow (water running down the stems/trunks and branches to the ground). Synonym such as 'stemflow' or 'flow along trunk' accepted.
points.partial_credit: Half if only described vaguely (e.g. 'flows down the tree') without the term or a clear equivalent.

points.description: Second blank: through fall (water dropping/falling through leaves or gaps in the canopy onto the ground). Synonym such as 'throughfall' or 'drip from leaves' accepted.
points.partial_credit: Half if only described vaguely (e.g. 'falls from leaves') without the term or a clear equivalent.

rubric.notes: Award 1 mark for each of stem flow and through fall, in either order, with clear synonyms accepted. Give part marks only for a vague description of the right path without the term. Wrong items such as evaporation, runoff or infiltration earn nothing for that blank.
